tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search product documentation by keyword. Returns matching document chunks ranked by relevance.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Retrieve the full content of a document by its ID.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List all indexed products and their versions.

tools.name: get_api_list
tools.description: List API classes and methods for a product. Returns structured class/method names with summaries. Use this to explore available APIs.

tools.name: get_api_detail
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific API (class or method). Returns method signatures, parameters, return values, and descriptions.

tools.name: get_example
tools.description: Get code examples for a specific API or feature keyword. Returns code snippets with descriptions.

tools.name: get_changelog
tools.description: Get version changelog / release notes for a product. Can filter by specific version or version range.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: Get the table of contents / section structure of a document without loading full content. Useful for navigating large documents.

tools.name: search_by_tag
tools.description: Search documents by tags or category keywords. Matches against section headings and content.

tools.name: get_related_docs
tools.description: Find documents related to a given document. Returns similar documents ranked by relevance.

tools.name: get_migration_guide
tools.description: Get migration guide and breaking changes between two versions. Shows what changed and how to adapt code.

tools.name: get_index_status
tools.description: Get current indexing status: document counts, chunk counts, and last update time per product/version.
